working_definition: Visceral muscle cells of the adult midgut from the gut analysis (Li et al. 2022; Manual Annotation, broad class muscle cell).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Muscle cell of a muscle of the adult midgut, surrounding the epithelium (Miller, 1950).

justification: Label names the location (midgut) and adult data; FBbt has this adult midgut muscle cell term.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any visceral muscle cell that is part of some midgut.
